name: Yoshioka (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yoshioka town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a small ring, with three pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshioka, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 1985.

features.role: Yoshioka town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a small ring, with three pointed strokes
